items.title: Cloudflare Workers Accept Inbound TCP, with gRPC the First Protocol on Top
items.summaryShort: Cloudflare Workers Accept Inbound TCP, with gRPC the First Protocol on Top. Cloudflare Workers can now accept inbound TCP connections through a new connect(socket) handler routed via Spectrum, ending an eight-year restriction to HTTP.
